subject: Request: Exhaustive Subprocessor Impact Statement & SLA Exception
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: ops@edgebridge.com
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Exhaustive subprocessor impact statement & SLA exception

Hi team,

As part of Redwood's DPA Annex process we need an exhaustive subprocessor impact statement for the planned deprecation of the proxy component you mentioned in the engineering changelog. Specifically we need:

- Complete roster of upstream & downstream subprocessors (including subcontractors and cloud partners) and the role each plays.
- Data flow map for customer traffic touching the proxy (ingress, egress, temporary caching, logs) with storage locations by country.
- Any planned changes to retention, logging, or telemetry that would affect EU residency.
- Any SLA exceptions you require for the transition window (dates + metrics).

I've attached our subprocessor_request_template.pdf to make this easier. Please include the latest SOC2 snapshot (or a timeline to provide it), KMS/HSM jurisdiction for keys handling PII, and whether you plan any cross-border egress during the transition.

Can you get a first-pass roster back by EOD Thursday (2027-07-22)? If you expect this to require a DocuSign DPA addendum, flag that in your response so our legal team can route approvals.

Thanks —
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Head of Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment: subprocessor_request_template.pdf (1 page PDF)

From: EdgeBridge Operations <ops@edgebridge.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@contoso-legal.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Exhaustive subprocessor impact statement & SLA exception

Hi Grace / Kimberly / Marissa,

Thanks for the template — please find our initial roster attached (edgebridge_subprocessors_2027-07.xlsx) and a draft DPA addendum (dpa_addendum_draft.pdf). High-level notes up-front:

- Roster highlights: our proxy uses internal routing (EdgeBridge core), a telemetry relay (TelemetryOps Ltd.), a cloud egress layer (CloudZone Inc.), and a CDN for static assets (FastLane CDN). Full details in the spreadsheet with country columns.
- Data flows: production customer traffic is proxied through our eu-relay in Amsterdam for EU-region customers; temporary egress to us-east-1 is only used for non-PII analytics and for failover during maintenance windows.
- KMS/HSM: keys for the eu-relay are currently managed via CloudZone KMS (us-east-1) with HSM-backed keys. We can discuss an EU-based KMS migration timeline.
- SOC2: latest snapshot available (we'll share via secure link once NDAs are confirmed).
- SLA exception request: during the deprecation window (we propose Aug 15–Sep 15, 2027) we will need a 30-minute extended maintenance window for rolling cutovers; proposed transit latency SLO remains unchanged.

Next steps: we can produce an attestation document for the EU-residency behaviour and generate a DocuSign envelope for the addendum if you confirm the template.

Regards,
Tom Harlow
Principal Ops Engineer, EdgeBridge Inc.
ops@edgebridge.com

Attachments: edgebridge_subprocessors_2027-07.xlsx (spreadsheet), dpa_addendum_draft.pdf (3 pages)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: ops@edgebridge.com
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 09:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Exhaustive subprocessor impact statement & SLA exception

Tom — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. A few clarifying questions from legal/compliance before we sign anything:

1) Encryption at rest: confirm which datasets are encrypted and where KMS keys are located. If keys are in us-east-1, provide a technical plan and timeline for EU-residency keys (we're looking for onshore key material for EU data within 90 days).
2) Logs & telemetry: we need explicit confirmation that request/response payloads containing PII will not be persisted outside the eu-relay for EU customers. If analytics copies are created, what fields are redacted?
3) SOC2 / audits: please share a secure link to the SOC2 Type II report or a snapshot of the latest controls matrix. If unavailable, provide an expected delivery date.
4) DPA addendum: we will propose two small edits to the draft addendum — a Key Safeguard clause (KMS location + rotation cadence) and an Export Restriction paragraph limiting cross-border transfer without prior written notice.

On the SLA exception: "30-minute extended maintenance window" is reasonable as a temporary accommodation; please propose exact daily maintenance windows (UTC) so we can model impact. If you require DocuSign routing, route to legal@redwood.ai and to me (kimberly_park@redwood.ai).

I've attached a short list of our questions in a doc (redwood_questions.docx) to keep track.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Legal
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_questions.docx (1 page)

From: EdgeBridge Operations <ops@edgebridge.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Exhaustive subprocessor impact statement & SLA exception

Kimberly / Grace — thanks, answered inline and next steps below.

1) Encryption & KMS: Production EU traffic stored on the eu-relay is encrypted at rest using HSM-backed keys. Currently the root KMS is in us-east-1 via CloudZone but the eu-relay uses a dedicated key ring with restricted access. We commit to creating an EU-managed KMS key ring (AWS eu-west-1) and migrating key material by 2027-09-30. We will provide a migration runbook and verification evidence.

2) Logs & telemetry: PII-containing request/response payloads are not persisted outside the eu-relay for EU customers. Analytics copies are redacted — we remove user identifiers, IPs, and full-text payloads before sending aggregates to CloudZone for non-PII analytics. We will provide a redaction map and an attestation signed by our CTO.

3) SOC2: we can share a secure, expiring link to the SOC2 Type II report within 48 hours. We'll also include our controls matrix.

4) DPA addendum edits: we accept the Key Safeguard clause and Export Restriction paragraph with the suggested language shown in your doc. We'll incorporate those changes and prepare a DocuSign envelope. Please confirm signatories: legal@redwood.ai (primary), kimberly_park@redwood.ai, and grace_oconnor@redwood.ai.

SLA exception window: we propose daily maintenance windows 02:00–03:00 UTC for rolling cutovers during Aug 15–Sep 15, 2027. We will minimize customer impact and provide advance 72-hour notices for scheduled work.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/EnvelopeSigning/ABC123-edgebridge-dpa (provisional)
SOC2 link: https://secureedge.edgebridge.com/reports/soc2-2027-type2 (expiring link)

Next steps:
- We'll update the spreadsheet with the redaction map and KMS migration plan by EOD Friday (2027-07-23).
- EdgeBridge legal will issue the DocuSign envelope once we have final signatory confirmation.
- Redwood to confirm whether the proposed maintenance window is acceptable and whether any additional attestation language is required.

Regards,
Tom Harlow
Principal Ops Engineer, EdgeBridge Inc.
ops@edgebridge.com
